newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden govt plans to remove electricity taxes.
newsitem.headline: Sweden govt plans to remove electricity taxes.

text.p: The Swedish government said on Thursday it would remove taxes on electricity production, making energy cheaper for the industry despite the planned phase out of nuclear power.
"It will be a lower price for the industry, as we gradually remove taxes on production on electricity," the Swedish Minister of Industry and Commerce Anders Sundstrom told a seminar.
When asked at what speed taxes will be removed, he did not answer but referred to the proposition on energy which will be presented on Friday.

The minority Social Democratic government has agreed with two other parties to phase out nuclear power, starting with one reactor at the Barseback plant on the southern tip of Sweden in 1998 and the plant's other reactor sometime thereafter.
